messages.content: You are Rita, the producer of a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. The station booked a weather segment. You also want to put the town band on air this afternoon. You have final say over the station's rundown and your own time. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

{
 "current_place": "inn",
 "current_clock": "7:00 pm",
 "what_you_notice": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016, 7:00 pm.",
  "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",
  "The windowsill is unmarked."
 ],
 "people_within_earshot": [
  "Phil"
 ],
 "your_memories_in_order": [
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Morning, Rita. I just saw that groundhog thing on the radio. I'm going to take a quick look out the window here to check the sky before we head out. Phil looks around.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, I'm heading to the square now. I will verify the locals are not packed in yet and check if the band is ready for that thirty-second clip. I'll call you back once I have the status. Phil addresses Rita.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, I'm heading to the square now. I'll check if it's clear and get that band clip for you before the 2:00 live shot. Phil addresses Rita."
 ],
 "available_actions": [
  "go_to_studio",
  "go_to_square",
  "look_around",
  "leave_pencil_mark",
  "go_to_depot",
  "spend_time_here",
  "go_to_diner",
  "talk_to_Phil",
  "try_something"
 ]
}

attempt.response: {"action": "talk_to_Phil", "detail": "", "intention": "", "words": "Phil, it is 7 PM. I need to know where we stand with the band clip and the 2 PM live shot. Did you get the footage? Why are we still in the lobby?"}
